reason: Specification v003 applies both answers: changed task statuses persist across reloads in browser storage (AC6, AC7 now firm), and under an active status filter a changed task leaves the list immediately (AC4 confirmed). Users get a labelled, keyboard-operable status control on each task, and the list, filter and results count update straight away. No open questions remain and no slices are proposed; the control's form and the storage format are left to planning.
